content:
I have spent a significant part of my career inside the Magento/Adobe Commerce ecosystem. Five-time Magento Master. Hundreds of enterprise implementations. Over a decade building community through events like Mage Titans and the Big Dam Run at Magento Imagine.

In this issue

  • The Pattern I Keep Seeing. When Adobe Commerce launched its PaaS cloud offering, it promised enterprise-grade infrastructure with vendor-managed support.
  • What Enterprise Customers Expect. Enterprise commerce is core revenue infrastructure, not a side project.
  • Meanwhile, Salesforce Keeps Moving. Enterprise teams evaluating Salesforce Commerce Cloud consistently report:
  • What I Wish Adobe Would Hear. 1. Recognize Magento Open Source as a viable enterprise funnel.
  • This Is Fixable. Adobe Commerce and Magento are "great platforms.
  • Final Thought. "Enterprise commerce platforms do not win or lose on features alone.
